root_cause: The patch applies ignore-paths filtering during recursive file discovery, which prevents pylint from loading its own internal checker modules when pylint itself is being linted or during test initialization
what_swarm_missed: The _is_ignored_file check in _discover_files is called when pylint loads ANY Python files recursively, including its own checkers and extensions during initialization
The patch doesn't distinguish between scanning user code vs scanning pylint's own codebase, causing pylint to filter out its own essential modules
The error 'c-extension-no-member' not found indicates pylint.extensions.typecheck wasn't loaded because it was filtered out by ignore-paths
116 test regressions all fail with the same root cause: pylint can't initialize properly because essential checkers are filtered out
behaviors_to_fix: Package directories (containing __init__.py) must be checked against ignore-paths before yielding them as modules to lint
Individual .py files within non-package directories must be checked against ignore-paths before yielding them
The ignore-paths filtering must ONLY apply to user code being linted, not to pylint's own modules during its initialization
test_analysis: The target test 'test_ignore_path_recursive_current_dir' expects that files matching ignore-paths pattern '^ignored_subdirectory/.*' are not linted. However, the fix causes ALL tests to fail because pylint can't even initialize - it tries to enable 'c-extension-no-member' but that checker was never loaded because the patch filtered out pylint/extensions/ files. The test expects exit code 0 but gets an UnknownMessageError exception instead.
suggestion: The fix should only apply ignore-paths filtering at the point where user-specified files/directories are being discovered for linting, not during pylint's internal module loading. An oracle that runs 'python -m pylint --version' after applying the patch would immediately catch that the patched pylint can't even start. Additionally, the fix location is wrong - it should filter at the point where files are added to the linting queue, not during low-level file discovery that's also used for loading pylint's own modules.
